verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes search, indexing, versioning, and storage-location flexibility (S3-compatible, NVMe, EBS) but contains no documentation about exporting data to open formats (e.g., Parquet, Arrow, CSV) or migrating away from LanceDB. The Apache-2.0 license shows the software is open-source but says nothing about data portability/export, and no probe or doc confirms an explicit open-format export path.
